title: Implement scrollable, searchable location dropdowns with cascading behavior

requirements.summary: Make the State dropdown fully scrollable with max-height of 60-70% of screen height
acceptanceCriteria: State dropdown scrolls smoothly when state list exceeds available space
Dropdown list has max-height set to 60-70% of viewport height
All states remain selectable without UI overlap

file_operations.description: Add scrollable container with max-height constraint to State dropdown. Apply CSS styles to enable smooth vertical scrolling when content exceeds 60-70vh. Ensure dropdown list container has overflow-y: auto and proper bounds to prevent UI overlap.

requirements.summary: Add search/filter functionality inside the State dropdown
acceptanceCriteria: Search input field appears at the top of the State dropdown
Typing filters the state list in real-time
Filtered results maintain scrollability

file_operations.description: Add search input field at the top of the State dropdown. Implement real-time filtering logic using React state to filter displayed states based on user input. Ensure filtered results remain scrollable and maintain the max-height constraint from REQ-1.

requirements.summary: Ensure cascading location selection behavior works correctly across all hierarchy levels
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting India as country loads Indian states
Selecting a state loads districts for that state
Selecting a district loads MP constituencies for that district
Selecting an MP constituency loads MLA constituencies
Selecting MLA constituency loads Mandals
Selecting Mandal loads Villages
Each level clears and resets subsequent dependent levels

file_operations.description: Verify and fix cascading behavior logic. Ensure that when Country = India is selected, all Indian states load. When a State is selected, fetch and display districts for that state. Continue cascade through District → MP Constituency → MLA Constituency → Mandal → Village. Implement proper state clearing for dependent dropdowns when a parent level changes. Use useLocationQueries hooks to fetch hierarchical data at each level.

Review and ensure all location query hooks (useGetDistrictsByState, useGetMPByDistrict, useGetMLAByMP, useGetMandalByMLA, useGetVillageByMandal) properly fetch data based on parent selection. Add placeholder implementations for any missing backend methods with clear TODOs. Verify caching and enabled conditions are correct for cascading behavior.

requirements.summary: Apply scroll behavior and search functionality to all location dropdowns
acceptanceCriteria: All location dropdowns (State, District, MP, MLA, Mandal, Village) have smooth scrolling
All location dropdowns have max-height of 60-70% viewport
All location dropdowns include search/filter functionality
Consistent UX across all dropdown levels

file_operations.description: Extend the scrollable container and search functionality implemented in REQ-1 and REQ-2 to all remaining location dropdowns: District, MP, MLA, Mandal, and Village. Create a reusable dropdown component or styling pattern that applies max-height (60-70vh), smooth scrolling (overflow-y: auto), and search input to each level. Ensure consistent styling and behavior across all six dropdown levels.

requirements.summary: Ensure mobile-responsive and touch-friendly scrolling for all location dropdowns
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdowns scroll smoothly on touch devices
No z-index conflicts preventing user interaction
All dropdown items are clickable and selectable
Overflow styles do not clip interactive elements

file_operations.description: Add mobile-responsive CSS properties for touch-friendly scrolling (webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, touch-action: pan-y). Review and fix z-index layering to ensure dropdowns appear above other content without blocking interaction. Verify that overflow styles do not clip clickable elements. Test tap targets meet minimum size requirements for mobile devices.

Add global CSS utilities or classes for scrollable dropdowns if needed, ensuring touch-friendly behavior and proper z-index stacking context. Define reusable scrollbar styling for consistency across all dropdowns.

requirements.summary: Optimize dropdown rendering performance to prevent UI freezing with large datasets
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown renders large lists without freezing
Scrolling remains smooth with datasets of 100+ items
Search/filter operations are performant on Android

file_operations.description: Implement performance optimizations for rendering large location lists. Consider using React.memo for dropdown items to prevent unnecessary re-renders. Optimize search filtering with debouncing or useMemo to avoid re-filtering on every keystroke. If dataset sizes exceed 200+ items, consider implementing virtualization (react-window or react-virtual) for dropdown lists. Test on Android devices to ensure smooth scrolling and filtering performance.
